newsitem.title: USA: Billboard cos could lose out on tobacco law - paper.
newsitem.headline: Billboard cos could lose out on tobacco law - paper.

text.p: Billboard companies could lose money under a new law imposed by the U.S. government to restrict tobacco advertising, according to the New York Times.

The law would force tobacco companies to spend less on certain forms of advertising, which could hurt billboard firms like Outdoor Systems Inc, the paper said Sunday in its business section column "Market Watch."

Nearly 10 percent of that company's revenues depends on tobacco ads, the story said, without specifying the source of its information. Outdoor became the largest U.S. billboard company after buying Gannett's outdoor advertising outfit, it added.
Executives at Outdoor Systems were unavailable immediately for comment.
